_doc: Verb allowlists for configuration_nix-command-catcher.nix. A verb here means the invocation is HEAVY (does real evaluation/build/activation work) and must be routed through nix-switch-progress-wrap. Any verb NOT listed passes straight through to the real binary with zero UI (nix eval, nix path-info, nix flake show, nixos-rebuild list-generations, etc). Add new heavy verbs here — never hardcode them in the wrapper script.
